gen-archivo-black-fs-neco: Neco swells gently from hairline to stem, with curves that never pinch shut. Neco's dignified classic serif feel carries a long page without strain, while Archivo Black stays blunt and urban above it.
gen-archivo-black-fs-recia: Recia has a sharp, authoritative look. Its light modulation only shows up on close inspection, so the classic serif sits quietly beneath Archivo Black, whose heavy, roomy letters do the shouting.
gen-audiowide-fs-rowan: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide towers over Rowan, whose serif curves open generously and feel friendly. And since Audiowide is so tall and wide, a modest heading size would likely be plenty.
gen-audiowide-gf-almendra: Sci-fi tiles meet old-world dignity. Almendra's deep lowercase midsection gives its classic serif text a bookish, steady pace over many paragraphs, while Audiowide keeps every stroke at one measured thickness.
gen-audiowide-gf-bree-serif: Audiowide's tech-minded letters hold one unvarying line weight, wide and tall, like tiles set with generous grout. Bree Serif, with its outsized lowercase, reads in a literary, refined voice.
gen-audiowide-gf-port-lligat-slab: Port Lligat Slab reads traditional and literary, its lowercase counters round as portholes and its curves left open to breathe. Audiowide is best at futuristic, uniform-stroke display; the slab serif handles the text.
gen-audiowide-gf-quando: Audiowide's futuristic letters never swell or taper, each glyph sitting wide apart like tiles. Shrink the heading and it loses punch; enlarge Quando and its tall middle zone grows loud.
gen-comfortaa-dm-sans: DM Sans reads approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s. Over a long page it stays friendly and easy, while Comfortaa's wire-like strokes add a geometric, neon-tube flourish up top.
gen-comfortaa-gf-aleo: Neon-tube curves meet a sturdy slab. Aleo's open counters let the eye slip in and out, and Comfortaa's wide-open rings keep the geometric friendliness going above its dignified classic serif.
gen-comfortaa-gf-almendra-sc: Comfortaa draws every curve like it was made with ruler and compass, stretched out and friendly. Almendra SC follows in an authoritative, dignified classic serif, its mouths staying open through a long passage.
